descriptionChirho: Qal intransitive: to get up, rise from a seated or lying position, or rise up in action (levantarse, उठना, قَامَ, 일어나다, kusimama/kuamka)
Qal stative: to stand in a place, remain standing, be upright or present (estar de pie, खड़ा होना/रहना, وَاقِف, 서 있다, kusimama)
Hifil causative with physical objects: to raise up, erect, or set in place a pillar, structure, or monument (erigir, खड़ा/खड़ी करना, أَقَامَ, 세우다, kusimamisha)
Hifil causative with persons or institutions: to appoint someone, constitute, or establish an office or arrangement (constituir/establecer, ठहराना/नियुक्त करना, أَقَامَ/أَقامُوا, 세우다, kuweka/kuteua)
Hofal passive: to be raised up, be made to stand, be erected by another agent (ser levantada/puesta de pie, उठाया जाना/खड़ा किया जाना, أُقِيمَتْ, 세워지다, kusimamishwa)
Piel intensive: to establish or confirm something firmly and enduringly (establecer firmemente, स्थापित करना, يُثَبِّتُ/لِيُثَبِّتَ, 세우다, kuweka)
